'''Mak Pra''' was [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual active during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], who operated on the planet [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] as the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] contact, while living amongst the native [[Jungle Felucian/Legends|Jungle Felucian]] species. When [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mavra Zane]] and her Padawans arrived on the planet, having escaped [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] custody, Pra coordinated with them his plan of an attack on the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] [[Presidente/Legends|Presidente]] [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai's]] headquarters. Along with the Jedi and the Jungle Felucians, Pra participated in the ensuing battle.

==Behind the scenes==
Mak Pra was created for the video game ''[[Kinect Star Wars]]'', and is voiced by [[Nolan North]].
